layout.advanced_locked: Your account has no calculator-advanced role
layout.footer: IAMClient4D sample · sign-in by Keycloak, tokens kept on this server

js.send_error: This web server is not reachable.
js.token_expired: expired: the next call refreshes it

home.lead_html: Calls go to the {backend} server. Switch it from the bar above: both servers have the same API, and each keeps its own history.
home.calculator_text: Powers, roots, logarithms, factorials, trigonometry, primes and combinatorics.
home.keypad_text: A calculator with keys for whole expressions, functions and constants. The statistics and equation keys need calculator-advanced.
home.advanced_text: Descriptive statistics and quadratic equations, with charts.
home.missing_role_403: you do not have it: the API answers 403
home.profile_text: What the API reads from your access token, and the token itself.
home.hero_lead: A web client of the two calculator REST servers. You sign in with Keycloak; this server keeps your tokens and calls the API for you.
home.step1_text: IAMClient4D builds the request on this server and sends the browser to Keycloak, bound to it by a short-lived cookie.
home.step2_title: Code exchange with the client secret
home.step2_text: Keycloak sends the browser back with a code; this server exchanges it for the tokens. They never reach the browser, which gets only an HttpOnly session cookie.
home.step3_text_html: Every calculation is an htmx request to this server, which calls the API with Authorization: Bearer, refreshing the token when it expires.
home.accounts_html: Accounts of the sample realm: student (calculator-user) and scientist (calculator-user, calculator-advanced); passwords in the README.

calculator.lead_html: Each form is an htmx request to this server, which calls {backend} with your access token. Endpoints with role calculator-user.
calculator.no_role_html: Your account has no calculator-user role: the API will answer 403.
calculator.trig_hint: asin, acos and atan return an angle in the chosen unit.
calculator.insert_constant: Constants into the last field you used:
calculator.result_empty: Run an operation: the request and the answer of the API appear here.

keypad.lead_html: Type or tap an expression: = sends it to {backend} (POST /api/expressions/evaluate, role calculator-user).
keypad.hint_html: Decimal point <kbd>.</kbd> · <kbd>EXP</kbd> writes the power of ten (1.5E3) · <kbd>Ans</kbd> the last result · <kbd>Enter</kbd> calculates, <kbd>Esc</kbd> clears.
keypad.advanced_hint_html: Values separated by ; on the display. x̄ σ statistics of a population, x̄ s of a sample, ax²+bx+c the equation of the coefficients a; b; c.
keypad.advanced_locked_html: These keys need the calculator-advanced role, which your account does not have.
keypad.quadratic: Quadratic equation of a; b; c

advanced.lead_html: Statistics and equations: POST endpoints with a JSON body and role calculator-advanced.
advanced.no_role_html: Your account has no calculator-advanced role. The forms still work: try one and see the 403 problem+json of the API. Sign in as scientist to use them.
advanced.values_hint: Separated by spaces, commas or new lines; decimal point.
advanced.quadratic_hint_html: Try 1 2 5 for complex roots, or a = 0 for the 422 of the API.

history.lead_html: Your last calculations on the {backend} server (GET /api/history). Each server keeps its own, in memory, keyed by the subject of your token.
history.clear_confirm: Clear your history on the {backend} server?
history.empty_html: Nothing yet: run an operation from the calculator.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: Who the API says you are, next to what this server keeps for you. The browser never sees the token: it holds only the session cookie.
profile.name: Name
profile.subject: Subject
profile.refresh_text: automatic, by IAMClient4D, on the first call after the expiry

errors.nothing_sent: Nothing was sent to the server.
errors.forbidden_hint_html: Your token is valid, but it lacks the role this endpoint asks for. Roles are client roles of api-server, given in Keycloak.
errors.token_refused: The server refused the access token.
errors.unauthorized_hint: Check that the server and this app use the same issuer (IAM4D_ISSUER) and audience.
errors.start_it: Start it, or switch to the other server.
errors.domain: A domain error of the calculator (422 problem+json).
errors.page_lead: The page could not be shown.

auth.refused_detail: This sign-in was not started by this browser, or it was already completed. Start again.
auth.failed_detail: Keycloak did not accept the sign-in. Start again.

input.list_not_number: "{value}" is not a number (use the decimal point)
input.session_ended: The Keycloak session has ended: sign in again.
input.three_coefficients: The equation needs the three coefficients a; b; c, not {count} values
